const data = $node["04 - Handle Source A Response"].json;
const normalized = data.jobs.map(job => ({
  schema_version: "1.0",
  job_id: "src_a_" + (job.id || Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5)),
  job_title: job.title || "Unknown Position",
  company: job.company || "Unknown Company",
  location: job.loc || "Unknown",
  source: "Source A (GlobalJobs API)",
  description: job.desc || "No description provided.",
  application_url: job.url || "https://example.com/apply",
  required_skills: job.skills_required ? job.skills_required.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()) : [],
  retrieved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  employment_type: "Full-time",
  seniority_level: job.experience_req_years >= 5 ? "Senior" : (job.experience_req_years >= 3 ? "Mid-Senior" : "Junior"),
  salary: null,
  education_requirement: job.desc && job.desc.includes("BS") ? "Bachelor's Degree" : null,
  required_experience_years: job.experience_req_years || 0,
  preferred_skills: [],
  technologies: job.skills_required ? job.skills_required.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()) : []
}));
return [{ json: { normalized } }];

const data = $node["08 - Handle Source B Response"].json;
const normalized = data.jobs.map(job => ({
  schema_version: "1.0",
  job_id: "src_b_" + (job.id || Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5)),
  job_title: job.jobTitle || "Unknown Position",
  company: job.companyName || "Unknown Company",
  location: job.locationInfo || "Unknown",
  source: "Source B (TechCareers API)",
  description: job.jobDescription || "No description provided.",
  application_url: job.jobUrl || "https://example.com/apply",
  required_skills: Array.isArray(job.skills) ? job.skills : [],
  retrieved_at: job.retrieved || new Date().toISOString(),
  employment_type: "Full-time",
  seniority_level: job.experienceYears >= 5 ? "Senior" : (job.experienceYears >= 3 ? "Mid-Senior" : "Junior"),
  salary: null,
  education_requirement: null,
  required_experience_years: job.experienceYears || 0,
  preferred_skills: [],
  technologies: Array.isArray(job.skills) ? job.skills : []
}));
return [{ json: { normalized } }];
